BrochureContent.Content:
An impressive and generously proportioned four bedroom residence extending to circa 183sqm enjoying stunning elevated views across Portmagee Channel and the Skelligs.
Occupying a superb setting, the property commands panoramic views over the surrounding countryside and provides an excellent base for those who enjoy walking, cycling and the relaxed coastal lifestyle. Knightstown and Chapeltown are both within a short drive.
The accommodation is spacious and well laid out. Comprising of a generous entrance hall with stone fronted porch, a bright living room, sunroom, master bedroom en-suite and walk in wardrobe, three further bedrooms, one of which is also en-suite, family bathroom, utility room and a large kitchen/dining area designed to take full advantage of the outstanding views. This home would be ideally suited as a full time residence, holiday home or retirement home.
Externally, the property benefits from a substantial detached garage circa 49sqm. The boundaries are clearly defined and the grounds are laid mainly to lawn.
Set on a site extending to approximately 0.6 acres, this attractive property combines space, privacy and spectacular scenery in one of the areas most sought after island locations.
